ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM will (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to 6 months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) return all Content in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after such expiry or termination; and (c) thereafter delete all Content from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.5 addresses only accrued payment obligations, so we have added an exit clause giving us up to 6 months of transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of our Content in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. The return deadline runs from expiry or termination rather than a later request.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, Content return in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion obligations into § 3.5 Effect of Termination.
